test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Aryan has to reach Ahmedabad which is 977 km away in 11 hours. His starting speed for 4 hours was 39 km/hr. For the next 140 km his speed was 35 km/hr. By what speed he must travel now so as to reach Ahmedabad in the decided time of 11 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 977 km, Total time = 11 hours.

Phase 1 distance = 39 × 4 = 156 km; Phase 2 distance = 140 km.

Remaining distance = 977 − (156 + 140) = 681 km.

Time taken = 4 + (140 ÷ 35) = 4 + 4 = 8 hours.

Remaining time = 11 − 8 = 3 hours.

Required speed = 681 ÷ 3 = 227 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 227 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3e20eedafe57272a98f82d4742521d4bd529b63c240ba7a1b02c8a95faadd3a.png] 

**Given:** Total Distance = 977 km, Total Time = 11 hours.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time | Time = Distance ÷ Speed

⇒ Distance covered in 1st part = 39 × 4 = 156 km

⇒ Time taken for 2ⁿd part = 140 ÷ 35 = 4 hours

⇒ Total distance covered so far = 156 + 140 = 296 km

⇒ Remaining distance = 977 − 296 = 681 km

⇒ Total time elapsed = 4 + 4 = 8 hours

⇒ Remaining time = 11 − 8 = 3 hours

⇒ Required Speed = 681 ÷ 3 = 227 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 227 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average Speed is defined as Total Distance ÷ Total Time. It is not the simple average of speeds.

Speed-Time Relationship

For a constant distance, Speed is inversely proportional to Time (S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
